`post({ id, at, memo, lines })` appends an immutable entry. Validation runs in this order, and nothing is stored unless every check passes: the entry must be an object (`'BAD_ENTRY'`, `entry must be an object`); `id` must be a non-empty string (`'BAD_ENTRY'`, `entry id must be a non-empty string`) that has not been used (`'DUPLICATE_ENTRY'`, `entry already exists: <id>`); `at` must be a non-negative integer (`'BAD_TIME'`); `memo` defaults to the empty string and must be a string (`'BAD_ENTRY'`); `lines` must be an array of at least two lines (`'TOO_FEW_LINES'`); then each line in turn must name an account that exists (`'UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT'`, `unknown account: <id>`), carry a safe integer `amountCents` (`'NOT_INTEGER'`) that is not zero (`'ZERO_LINE'`); and finally the amounts must sum to zero (`'UNBALANCED'`). The stored entry is frozen and exposes `id`, `at`, `seq` (its 1-based posting order), `memo`, `lines`, `reverses` and `reversedBy`, the last two null for an ordinary entry. `getEntry(id)` returns it or `undefined`. `entries({ asOf })` returns the entries with `at` at or before the cut-off, ordered by `at` and then by posting order; `asOf` defaults to `Infinity` and must otherwise be a non-negative integer. Entries may be posted in any time order.

`balance(accountId, { asOf })` sums the account's lines over the entries in force at that moment, keeping the debit-positive sign; `normalBalance` reports the same figure in the account's own direction. `trialBalance({ asOf })` returns `{ debits, credits, byAccount }` with every account present, `debits` the sum of the positive balances and `credits` the absolute sum of the negative ones; because entries balance, the two totals are always equal and the balances always sum to zero. `reverse(entryId, { id, at, memo })` posts the mirror image of an entry, negating every line, defaulting the memo to `reversal of <entryId>`, recording `reverses` on the new entry and `reversedBy` on the old one. Finish the ledger in `src/`. `src/index.js` re-exports `ACCOUNT_TYPES`, `LedgerError`, `normalSide` and `toNormal` from `src/money.js` and `Ledger` from `src/ledger.js`; keep that surface. Amounts are integer cents in one signed convention: a positive amount is a debit and a negative amount is a credit, so a balanced entry sums to zero. The account types are `asset`, `liability`, `equity`, `income` and `expense`; `normalSide(type)` returns `'debit'` for assets and expenses and `'credit'` for the other three, and `toNormal(type, signedCents)` negates the debit-positive figure for credit-normal types. Both throw `'UNKNOWN_TYPE'` with message `unknown account type: <type>` for anything else.

`openAccount({ id, name, type })` registers an account and returns it frozen. It throws `'BAD_ACCOUNT'` with message `account must be an object` for a non-object, `account id must be a non-empty string` or `account name must be a non-empty string` for those fields, `'UNKNOWN_TYPE'` for an unknown type, and `'DUPLICATE_ACCOUNT'` with message `account already exists: <id>` for a repeat. `accounts()` lists the accounts in ascending id order.

`post({ id, at, memo, lines })` appends an immutable entry. Validation runs in this order, and nothing is stored unless every check passes: the entry must be an object (`'BAD_ENTRY'`, `entry must be an object`); `id` must be a non-empty string (`'BAD_ENTRY'`, `entry id must be a non-empty string`) that has not been used (`'DUPLICATE_ENTRY'`, `entry already exists: <id>`); `at` must be a non-negative integer (`'BAD_TIME'`); `memo` defaults to the empty string and must be a string (`'BAD_ENTRY'`); `lines` must be an array of at least two lines (`'TOO_FEW_LINES'`); then each line in turn must name an account that exists (`'UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT'`, `unknown account: <id>`), carry a safe integer `amountCents` (`'NOT_INTEGER'`) that is not zero (`'ZERO_LINE'`); and finally the amounts must sum to zero (`'UNBALANCED'`). The stored entry is frozen and exposes `id`, `at`, `seq` (its 1-based posting order), `memo`, `lines`, `reverses` and `reversedBy`, the last two null for an ordinary entry. `getEntry(id)` returns it or `undefined`. `entries({ asOf })` returns the entries with `at` at or before the cut-off, ordered by `at` and then by posting order; `asOf` defaults to `Infinity` and must otherwise be a non-negative integer. Entries may be posted in any time order.

`balance(accountId, { asOf })` sums the account's lines over the entries in force at that moment, keeping the debit-positive sign; `normalBalance` reports the same figure in the account's own direction. `trialBalance({ asOf })` returns `{ debits, credits, byAccount }` with every account present, `debits` the sum of the positive balances and `credits` the absolute sum of the negative ones; because entries balance, the two totals are always equal and the balances always sum to zero. `reverse(entryId, { id, at, memo })` posts the mirror image of an entry, negating every line, defaulting the memo to `reversal of <entryId>`, recording `reverses` on the new entry and `reversedBy` on the old one.
